positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maps Driving Quality - Developed traffic congestion and ETA ML models using Graph Convolutional Networks in C++ and Tensorflow. Built and maintained end-to-end ML pipelines that cover training, deploying, serving, logging, and monitoring. Optimized batch pipelines processing petabytes of data using Google Dataflow (2018–Present).

Cloud Endpoints - Developed scalable web pages and components for managing service quotas and usages in AngularJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Java. Built a scalable web page that visualizes API usages for +1000 hierarchical projects (2017–2018).

AdWords DoubleClick Search - Developed scalable web pages and components for ads bidding strategy and bidding state monitoring in GWT, AngularDart, and Java. Designed and developed a budget optimization feature. Built a backend batch job building monthly invoices for customers (2014–2017).

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Learned and analyzed player behavior in education games using ML techniques.

company.name: Center for Game Science, University of Washington

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Developed Lineage Eternal, a MMORPG, as a team. Mainly worked on a client-side game engine, especially for the game AI and character animation. Built and refined tools for animators and level designers.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked on controlling biped characters in real-time with mocap animation data. Used reinforcement learning and inverse reinforcement learning to learn data-based controllers.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Built an animation framework for avatars in a virtual world.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Designed a trading agent for the annual Trading Agent Competition(TAC). Roxybot, our agent, won in 2006. Used ILP to model competitors, predict bidding prices, and compute the best bidding strategy.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Refined scientific visualization and UI for CAVE(CAVE Automatic Virtual Environment), a virtual environment using 3D glasses.

company.name: Center for Computation and Visualization, Brown Univeristy
